dialogue.origin: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for meeting with me today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 少しお時間早いですが始めてもよろしいでしょうか？ジャストにいたしますか？
dialogue.content: We’re a little early—would it be alright to begin now, or would you prefer to start exactly on time?

dialogue.origin: 始めていただいて大丈夫です。打つのが遅いですが、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It’s fine to begin. I type slowly, so please bear with me.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。では、始めさせていただきますね。大丈夫です。私も右手骨折してギブスです＾＾；
dialogue.content: Thank you. Let's begin then. It's no problem at all. I actually have my right hand in a cast from a fracture. ^^;

dialogue.origin: 暑い時期に骨折はつらいです…
dialogue.content: Breaking a bone in this hot weather must be tough...

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。こんな大事な時期に・・・では、始めますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. At such an important time... Alright, let’s get started.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I am your counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: 初めて利用します…
dialogue.content: This is my first time using this service...

dialogue.origin: かしこまりましたよろしくお願いいたしますニックネームでも構いませんのでなんとお呼びさせて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. It's a pleasure to assist you. May I ask what you would like to be called? A nickname is perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: ウサノスケです（笑）住んでいる住居のことで悩んでいます…おトイレの問題です
dialogue.content: You can call me Usanosuke (laughs). I’m having trouble with my current housing... it’s an issue with the toilet.

dialogue.origin: 一人暮らしで、今年２月にトイレが故障して直してもらいました
dialogue.content: I live alone, and my toilet broke in February of this year, so I had it repaired.

dialogue.origin: ウサノスケさんですね始めてでご不安でしょうが、丁寧に対応させていただきますのでよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Usanosuke-san, I understand you may feel anxious since this is your first time, but I will do my best to support you, so please feel at ease.

dialogue.origin: はい、おトイレの故障のお困りごとですね
dialogue.content: I see, so it's a problem with a malfunctioning toilet.

dialogue.origin: よかったです…こんな内容でいいかなと、不安でした
dialogue.content: I’m relieved... I was worried if it was okay to talk about something like this.

dialogue.origin: トイレの故障の件です
dialogue.content: Yes, it's about the toilet malfunction.

dialogue.origin: お住まいに関しては大事なことです
dialogue.content: Issues with your home are very important.

dialogue.origin: ご安心してお話お聞かせください
dialogue.content: Please don't hesitate to tell me all about it.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 2月に修理なさったとの事ですが、それからも何かありましたか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you had it repaired in February. Has something happened since then?

dialogue.origin: 2月にトイレの故障を直した後に、二階に住んでいる方から水漏れしてると苦情がきました…
dialogue.content: After I had the toilet fixed in February, the person living on the floor above me complained about a water leak...

dialogue.origin: 修理なさったのにそれはお困りですね
dialogue.content: That must be troubling, especially after you just had it repaired.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 原因は建物の水道管の劣化が原因でした…
dialogue.content: The cause was the deterioration of the building's water pipes...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか二階の方の水漏れは確認なさりに行かれたのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Did you go to check on the water leak in the upstairs neighbor's apartment?

dialogue.origin: 確認はしていないです…
dialogue.content: I haven't checked it myself...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね建物の老朽化という事は、保証などはないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Since it's due to the building aging, is there no warranty or insurance coverage?

dialogue.origin: 2月にトイレの故障を直したときに、業者さんから「水道管が劣化してるから大家さんに言った方がいい」と言われました…
dialogue.content: When I had the toilet fixed in February, the repair person told me, "The water pipes are deteriorating, so you should tell your landlord."

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その時はウサノスケさんが修理代をお支払いになられたのですね
dialogue.content: So at that time, you paid for the repairs yourself, Usanosuke-san?

dialogue.origin: はい…7万5千円でした
dialogue.content: Yes... it was 75,000 yen.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか思わぬ出費でお辛かったですね
dialogue.content: I see. That unexpected expense must have been difficult.

dialogue.origin: ビックリしました…
dialogue.content: I was shocked...

dialogue.origin: 大家さんには連絡しましたが、まだ、水道管の修理をしていなくて、在宅勤務なのでトイレが困ります…
dialogue.content: I contacted the landlord, but they haven't repaired the pipes yet, and since I work from home, the toilet situation is very difficult...

dialogue.origin: 二階の水漏れのたびに、業者が来ます…
dialogue.content: A repair person comes every time there's a leak upstairs...

dialogue.origin: かなりの高額ですよね生活費にも影響は大きかったでしょう大家さんの対応がまだなのですね
dialogue.content: That's a considerable amount of money. It must have had a big impact on your living expenses. And the landlord hasn't responded yet, I see.

dialogue.origin: ええ！！それではその度にウサノスケさんが修理代のご負担を？
dialogue.content: What! So does that mean you have to pay for the repairs each time?

dialogue.origin: 修理代は２月の初めの修理の時だけです
dialogue.content: I only paid for the initial repair in February.

dialogue.origin: 二階の水漏れの原因が水道管の劣化なので、大家さんが負担していると思います。
dialogue.content: Since the cause of the leak upstairs is the deteriorating pipes, I think the landlord is paying for it.

dialogue.origin: 二階の方が「臭い」と言って怒っていますが
dialogue.content: But the person upstairs is angry, saying it smells.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか少し安心しましたが、水漏れの度に２階の方が報告に来られる訳ですよね
dialogue.content: I see, that's a small relief. But it means the upstairs neighbor comes to complain to you every time there's a leak, correct?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 被りましたすみません
dialogue.content: Sorry, we typed at the same time.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ
dialogue.content: No, no, it's okay.

dialogue.origin: 不動産屋にも連絡しましたが、大家さんに言ってくださいと言われました
dialogue.content: I also contacted the real estate agency, but they just told me to talk to the landlord.

dialogue.origin: 水漏れの度に、怒られながらの報告では参ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It must be exhausting to be angrily confronted every time there's a leak.

dialogue.origin: では、
dialogue.content: So,

dialogue.origin: 大家さんの大々的な修理はまだされず、日々嫌な思いを抱えていらっしゃるという事ですね
dialogue.content: The landlord hasn't done any major repairs yet, and you're left to deal with these unpleasant feelings every day. Is that correct?

dialogue.origin: はい！そうなんです…トイレに行きづらくて困ってます
dialogue.content: Yes! That's it... It's making it hard for me to even use my own toilet.

dialogue.origin: 引越しも考えています…
dialogue.content: I'm even thinking about moving...

dialogue.origin: 在宅の為、頻繁にご使用になられるでしょうから精神的負担も大きいですよね
dialogue.content: Since you work from home, you probably need to use it often, so the mental burden must be huge.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです…ストレスです
dialogue.content: Exactly... it's very stressful.

dialogue.origin: お引越しを考えていらしゃる程追い詰められておいでなのですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're feeling cornered, to the point of considering moving.

dialogue.origin: 業者さんに問合せをしたら、水道管の劣化だと、ビルの水道管の修理は時間もかかると言っていました
dialogue.content: When I asked the repair company, they said that repairing a building's deteriorating pipes takes a lot of time.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね大々的な工事になられるんでしょうねしかし、
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like it would be a major construction project. However,

dialogue.origin: ２階の方もご理由はご存じだと思うのですがまるでウサマルさんが加害者のような言い方は酷いですよね
dialogue.content: I assume the upstairs neighbor knows the reason for the leaks, but it's terrible that they speak to you as if you're the one at fault, Usamaru-san.

dialogue.origin: 二階の方は主婦の方なので…
dialogue.content: The person upstairs is a housewife...

dialogue.origin: ウサノスケさん、お名前間違えてしまいもうしわけありません・・・
dialogue.content: Usanosuke-san, I am so sorry for getting your name wrong...

dialogue.origin: いえいえ
dialogue.content: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.origin: 話を聴いていただけて、ホッとしています
dialogue.content: I feel relieved just having someone listen to me.

dialogue.origin: すみませんでいた、ありがとうございますはい、２階の方は主婦のかたなのですね
dialogue.content: I apologize for that, and thank you for your understanding. So, the person upstairs is a housewife, I see.

dialogue.origin: はい…二階の方から「臭い」とか言われると自分が悪いように感じてしまいます
dialogue.content: Yes... When the upstairs neighbor says things like "it smells," I start to feel like it's my fault.

dialogue.origin: 友人は引越しをすすめてきます
dialogue.content: My friends are advising me to move.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね加害者にされた気分にならされてしまいますよねウサノスケさんも、お引越しには現実的にお考えの部分もあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It must feel like you're being treated as the culprit. Are you seriously considering moving as a realistic option, Usanosuke-san?

dialogue.origin: 仕事はコロナでも在宅勤務で収入は安定しているので大丈夫です…
dialogue.content: I work from home due to COVID, and my income is stable, so that's not a problem...

dialogue.origin: では、今の現状で我慢しているよりお引越しも視野にいれて考え始めていらしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So, rather than enduring the current situation, you're starting to consider moving as an option.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: お引越しに関しては、精神的ご負担はおありにはなられないですか？
dialogue.content: Regarding moving, would that not be a mental burden for you as well?

dialogue.origin: 引越しで新しい環境になるのも、正直キツいですが、トイレの苦痛よりはまだ良いと思っています
dialogue.content: Moving to a new environment would be tough, honestly, but I think it's still better than the distress the toilet situation is causing.

dialogue.origin: トイレの苦痛と二階の方が…辛いです
dialogue.content: The toilet problem and the person upstairs... it's just too much.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね建物の老朽化により大々的な修理が必要ではあるけど、大家さんは具体的に計画をしめしてくれていない、
dialogue.content: I understand. So, although major repairs are needed due to the building's age, the landlord hasn't given you any concrete plans,

dialogue.origin: はい…修理については、何も…
dialogue.content: Right... nothing has been said about repairs...

dialogue.origin: 今日も、二階の方が来たので、こちらにご相談しました…
dialogue.content: The upstairs neighbor came by again today, which is why I decided to seek counseling...

dialogue.origin: 在宅の為、トイレを使うのも気が重く、二階の住人の怒った報告も大きな精神的ご負担になられ、引っ越しも考えてる。といった感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, because you work from home, you feel anxious using the toilet, and the angry complaints from the upstairs resident have become a huge mental burden, leading you to consider moving. Does that summarize it?

dialogue.origin: はい…こんな事ってあるんだなぁと思いながらも、迷っていて…半年以上なもので
dialogue.content: Yes... I keep thinking, "I can't believe this is happening," and I've been unsure what to do... it's been over half a year.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: なんだか引越しを真剣に考えてみようかと
dialogue.content: I’m starting to think I should seriously consider moving.

dialogue.origin: 日々怯える様に我慢なさっておられる所に今日も２階の方が来られたのでは引っ越しも現実に考え始めてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: You've been enduring this, living in fear every day, and then the upstairs neighbor comes again today... it's natural that you'd start to think of moving as a real option.

dialogue.origin: 引越し先を探してみた方が気持ちもラクになりそうな気がしてきました
dialogue.content: I feel like I might feel more at ease if I just start looking for a new place.

dialogue.origin: 業者さんの話しの内容でも、大家さんの様子も変わらないですし（笑）
dialogue.content: Based on what the repair company said and the landlord's lack of action, it doesn't seem like things will change (laughs).

dialogue.origin: そうですね引っ越しと簡単に言っても、資金面や、物件探し、色々と大変な事もおありかともおもいますが今のウサノスケさんの精神状態では先ずは気軽に不動産屋さん巡りだけでもしてみた方が良いかと思えてきています
dialogue.content: That makes sense. Moving isn't easy, with finances, finding a new place, and all the other challenges, but given your current mental state, I think it might be a good idea to at least start by casually visiting some real estate agencies.

dialogue.origin: 二階の方の言葉はけっこう傷つきます。なんだか、まとまらなかった考えがまとまりました！私は腹が立っていたんだと思います…
dialogue.content: The words from my upstairs neighbor really hurt. I feel like my jumbled thoughts have finally come together! I think I was just really angry...

dialogue.origin: 不動産屋さん巡りしてみます
dialogue.content: I’ll try visiting some real estate agencies.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！！２階の方だって老朽化の中にいる訳ですからいつ自分が１階の方に同じ事になる事もある訳なのに、本当に身勝手な方と思います！
dialogue.content: Exactly! The upstairs neighbor is also living in the same old building, so they could easily be in the same situation with the person below them someday. It's truly selfish of them!

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、私は精神的負担がかかっていました単純なストレスじゃなかったです
dialogue.content: You're right. It was a huge mental burden on me. It wasn't just simple stress.

dialogue.origin: スッキリしました
dialogue.content: I feel so much better now.

dialogue.origin: よく、半年間お耐えになってこられましたねお辛かったですよね
dialogue.content: You endured that for six months. That must have been so difficult.

dialogue.origin: 先ずは、
dialogue.content: First of all,

dialogue.origin: 現実に引っ越しを直ぐに行動するのではなく、気軽な感じで不動産屋さん巡りをすることがよいかな。と思っています
dialogue.content: I think it would be good to start by casually looking at real estate agencies, rather than feeling pressured to move immediately.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 良き物件が見つかったら良いですね！！
dialogue.content: I hope you find a great new place!

dialogue.origin: 辛かった自分に気づかなかったですが、気づけてよかったです！
dialogue.content: I didn't realize how much pain I was in, but I'm glad I do now!

dialogue.origin: いい物件みつけるパワーに変えます（笑）
dialogue.content: I’ll turn this into the energy to find a great place (laughs).

dialogue.origin: そう感じて良かったですご自身を労わってあげてくださいね
dialogue.content: I’m glad you feel that way. Please be gentle with yourself.

dialogue.origin: 怒っていた自分に気づけてよかったです！
dialogue.content: I’m glad I realized I was angry!

dialogue.origin: トイレ話でしたが、聴いてくださって、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Even though it was about the toilet, thank you for listening!

dialogue.origin: はい、混乱していたり傷つきすぎると自分を責めてしまう事もありますどうかご自身を大事にしてあげてくださいそして、良き新居と、良き住人に巡り会える事願っています
dialogue.content: Yes—when we’re confused or deeply hurt, we can end up blaming ourselves. Please take good care of yourself, and I hope you find a good new home and good neighbors.

dialogue.origin: 温かいお言葉、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your kind words.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話お聞かせ下さりありがとうございました又、何かありましたらお気軽にお越しくださいね
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your story with me today. If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to reach out.

dialogue.origin: また、何かありましたらご相談しにきます！！！
dialogue.content: I’ll come consult again if anything comes up!!!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: はい、こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 今日はこれで終了となりますが大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: This concludes our session for today. Is that alright?

dialogue.origin: 大変、勉強になりました。
dialogue.content: This has been very enlightening.

dialogue.origin: 修了なさって大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, it's okay to end the session.

dialogue.origin: (時間オーバーにお付き合いくださりありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for staying past our scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: (又、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします。では失礼いたしますね)
dialogue.content: (I hope we can speak again. Take care.)

dialogue.origin: （とんでもないことです…感謝しております。こちらこそ、またお会いできましたら、よろしくお願いいたします。失礼いたします。）
dialogue.content: (Not at all... I'm very grateful. Likewise, I hope to speak with you again. Goodbye.)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそありがとうございました。では、終了ボタン押させていただきます。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. I will now press the end session button.)

topic.sub: 住居の水漏れによる精神的ストレス
